routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_review_log_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'review logs are immutable'; END $function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER quiz_answer_reviews_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON quiz_answer_reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_review_log_update()
triggers.name: quiz_answer_reviews_immutable

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER review_logs_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON review_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_review_log_update()
triggers.name: review_logs_immutable
